links.comparator_used: Simple prompt without explicit triage expectations (generic prompt relying on built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Between-model variance in triage accuracy across 23 LLMs, size-accuracy and accuracy-cost associations
links.effect: Between-model variance in accuracy fell 5.3-fold (0.014 to 0.003; Levene P=.01). Size-accuracy association went from rho=0.42 (P=.047) to rho=-0.05 (P=.83), and the accuracy-cost relationship was removed.
links.tradeoff: Under-triage errors persisted with some LLMs. The advanced prompt bundled explicit triage expectations with worked examples, so the effect of the expectations alone is not isolated.
links.quote: Advanced prompting minimised between-model variance in accuracy 5.3-fold (0.014 to 0.003; Levene P=.01), abolished the size-accuracy association (rho=-0.05; P=.83) and removed the accuracy-cost relationship.
